dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000pysg](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000pysg) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 26.072 depth occurred on Mar 14 2025 62km W of Batubangga. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 1.1364 longitude 120.2317. It impacted 41397 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
